firstLookSummaries.body: Overall the approach is good but there are a few things to clean up before merging.

instructions: Review each body under `## Review summaries (first look)`. Eligible non-human IDs are already in `--minimize-comment-ids`. Record any warranted Shepherd Journal note before review mutations.

For any substantial decision or rejection, append `- <decision>` to Shepherd Journal with `pr-shepherd apply journal https://github.com/owner/repo/pull/42 '- <decision>'`. See "Shepherd Journal" in the pr-shepherd skill for citation conventions.
`[FIX_CODE]` is non-terminal. After completing these steps, iterate immediately with the same options to continue.
